resumen: Reserva: lunes 21 de septiembre a las 8:00, Dr. Andrés Sáez, Arenal Norte

eventos.texto: Good morning, Clínica Arenal, you're through to reception. How can I help you today?
Good morning. I need to see a GP. The earliest you have in the morning?
Entiende cuándo la quiere: lo antes posible
Could I take your full name, and either your DNI or NIE, or the phone number on your file?
Mario García López My DNI is 399588
DNI oído 399588: 6 dígitos (hacen falta 8)
La letra del DNI no cuadra: lo vuelve a pedir
I think I misheard the DNI, because the letter doesn't match the numbers. Could you read it again?
DNI oído 38: 2 dígitos (hacen falta 8)

thirtieth of July, nineteen seventy-five

Ofrece el lunes 21 de septiembre a las 8:00 con el Dr. Andrés Sáez en Arenal Norte
Thank you, Mario, I have your record here. The earliest I have in the morning is Monday the 21st of September at 8 am with Dr. Andrés Sáez at Arenal Norte. Shall I book that for you?
Yes, book it please.
Reserva · lunes 21 de septiembre, 8:00 · Dr. Andrés Sáez · Arenal Norte
That's booked: Monday the 21st of September at 8 am with Dr. Andrés Sáez at Arenal Norte. Is there anything else I can help with?
No, that's everything. Thanks.
Thank you for calling. Take care, goodbye.
